gloss: to nod (in agreement); to say yes; to give one's consent

definitions.gloss: to nod (in agreement); to say yes; to consent
definitions.explanation: To nod one's head vertically, indicating agreement or approval. Often used in the negative to describe someone refusing to agree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}らない。
⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}って⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My father finally gave his approval.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説得|せっとく}して→説得する：21139_settokusuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}ろうとしなかった。
examples.english: No matter how much I tried to persuade her, she wouldn't agree.

notes:
USAGE:
More often used in the NEGATIVE ({首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}らない) to describe refusal or reluctance to agree. The affirmative is used when emphasizing that consent was finally obtained.
More vivid and emphatic than simply ⟦{同意|どうい}する→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧ (to agree) or うなずく (to nod). Often used when the agreement or refusal is significant or hard-won.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}る (to nod yes)
- ⟦{首|くび}を{横|よこ}に{振|ふ}る→首を横に振る：19743_kubiwoyokonifuru⟧ (to shake one's head no)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}らない (won't easily agree)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}る (to finally agree)
- {首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}ろうとしない (to refuse to agree)
